mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, keyword AS keyword, last_search_time AS lastSearchTime FROM search_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_search_time DESC, history_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_history ( user_id, keyword, last_search_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{keyword}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_search_time = VALUES(last_search_time)
